text: {"action": "reply", "content": "Our general return policy for all products, including vacuum cleaners, allows customers to return items within 30 days of delivery. The order status must be 'delivered' to be eligible for a return. Customers need to confirm the order ID and the items to be returned. The refund will be processed to the original payment method or an existing gift card. After confirmation, the order status will change to 'return requested', and the user will receive an email with instructions on how to return the items. Please note that the item must be in its original condition and packaging for a full refund to be issued."}
